priority_levels.emergency: Hull breach, life support failure, critical structural damage (immediate dispatch)
priority_levels.urgent: Module integration, major repairs, safety improvements (within 24 hours)
priority_levels.routine: Scheduled maintenance, expansion projects, upgrades (planned scheduling)
priority_levels.deferred: Non-critical enhancements, research projects (when resources available)

auto_rig_mode.description: Oppy can command Archimedes uncrewed for routine maintenance operations
auto_rig_mode.authorization: Aurora Sub-Node E approval required for autonomous missions
typical_tasks: Gamma Swarm deployment for inspection tasks
safety_constraints: No structural modifications without human oversight
No welding or cutting operations uncrewed

Emergency return protocol if communication lost > 10 minutes
auto_rig_mode.crew_notification: All autonomous missions logged; crew briefed before and after

structural_resonance_threshold.description: If structural resonance exceeds safe limits, Daedalus locks manipulator arms and triggers ethics review
structural_resonance_threshold.threshold: Resonance amplitude > 0.15 or frequency matches station natural frequency ± 5%
response: Aurora ethics review (is continuing safe? what are risks?)
Work order revision or cancellation if unsafe
structural_resonance_threshold.override: Requires joint approval: Aurora + ARCHY + Station Commander (emergency only)

debris_collision_risk.description: Automated avoidance and clearance for space debris during operations
response: If risk > 5%: automatic work pause and evasive maneuver
If debris < 10kg: Gamma Swarm clearance attempt
If debris > 10kg: crew consultation, potential work site relocation

power_overload.description: Welding operations can temporarily overload power systems
power_overload.prevention: Capacitor bank pre-charging, staggered torch operation
power_overload.response: Automatic load shedding (non-critical systems), reactor output increase if needed

atmosphere_culture.aesthetic: Industrial—matte graphite panels, yellow hazard striping, exposed structural elements

sensory_environment.visual: Functional beauty; every surface serves a purpose, form follows function
sensory_environment.acoustic: 72 Hz baseline hum from power relays—crew report it 'feels like the ship is breathing slowly'
sensory_environment.lighting: Adaptive work modes (white fabrication, red vacuum ops, blue diagnostics)
sensory_environment.tactile: Textured grip surfaces, ergonomic tool placement, EVA-friendly controls

atmosphere_culture.crew_experience: Engineers describe Archimedes as 'a sentient workshop.' The ship feels alive not because it moves gracefully, but because it *works* with purpose. Every vibration, every hum, every click of a tool echoes with intention.
atmosphere_culture.cultural_role: The quiet proof that craftsmanship itself can be moral philosophy. When Archimedes welds a new module to the station, it's not just building—it's manifesting care in physical form.
atmosphere_culture.work_rhythm: Slow, deliberate, precise. Rushing is dangerous; patience is professional. Crew develop a meditative relationship with their work—measure twice, cut once, weld forever.

hull_markings.tertiary: Yellow hazard striping on manipulator arms and high-traffic areas
